description: LoRA baseline arms trained with the same DPO objective, pairs and held-out prompts as the single-embedding neologism. The <ENSURE_LONG> token stays at its untrained random initial vector; only the adapters learn.
learning_rate_note: Learning rates are fixed, not tuned on held-out data.

lora_matched.budget_note: Closest standard LoRA to 896 parameters: rank 1 on one 896->128 projection = 1,024 parameters.

lora_r8_qv.budget_note: Typical LoRA setting (rank 8, alpha 16, lr 1e-4 as in qwen-lora-finetuning), q_proj and v_proj in every layer. Parameter count is reported, not matched.
